metadata.citation: O. Reg. 665/98 (Hunting), s. 66(1): Sunday gun hunting prohibition applies only south of the French and Mattawa rivers
metadata.divide_source: Derived from the shared boundary between northern and southern Wildlife Management Units, which O. Reg. 663/98 Part 6 defines along the French and Mattawa rivers. The WMU boundary is MNRF's own digitisation of the regulatory line.

properties.name: North of the French and Mattawa rivers
